intro: Oggleflint is the chieftain of the trogg tribe dwelling within the volcanic depths of Ragefire Chasm directly beneath Orgrimmar. His troggs have been creeping up from the lava-filled tunnels toward the surface, and from his place near the cavern's entrance he commands a savage pack that poses an immediate threat to the Horde capital above.

p: Oggleflint and his troggs climbed out of the fiery tunnels deep beneath Orgrimmar and into Ragefire Chasm. Brutal and territorial, they carved out a primitive domain among the molten rock. Though troggs possess little in the way of advanced civilization, Oggleflint maintained absolute authority over the pack through sheer brute strength.

When Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem sent diplomats into the chasm to make peace with the troggs, the troggs turned on them and killed them. The body of one envoy, Maur Grimtotem, lay in the caverns under Oggleflint's watch. The trogg chieftain now waits near the cavern entrance, striking at any outsider who comes down into the dark.

Having troggs directly beneath Thrall's capital is a hazard the Horde cannot tolerate. Creeping closer to the surface, Oggleflint's tribe is far too volatile to leave unchecked, threatening to spill into the Drag and Cleft of Shadow if left undisturbed.
